subject: ClearPath pilot — DPA annex, audit path & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@clearpathhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-18T08:15:00Z
Subject: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We are moving the ClearPath pilot into a procurement review and need a short packet from Redwood to satisfy our legal/privacy team before we can sign the pilot SOW. Specifically they asked for:

- The DPA / Data Processing Appendix language you propose for the pilot (audit clause + onshore options).
- A redacted Article 30 register excerpt or equivalent processing ledger covering the services used in the pilot.
- Subprocessor list and evidence of attestation (SOC2 + signing).
- Any DPIA support statement you can provide (we're doing a high-level DPIA and would like a note on your role and controls).
- KMS/crypto wrap details and whether EU key management/onshore wrapping is an option for the pilot.

Attached is our RFP appendix for context. Can you confirm what you can provide and a realistic delivery timeline? We are hoping to complete procurement review by 10/04.

Appreciate it — Emma

Emma Jones
Head of Procurement, ClearPath Health
emma.jones@clearpathhealth.com
+44 20 7000 1212

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Emma — thanks for the clear list and the RFP appendix (received). Short answer: we can provide everything you listed, with a few clarifying notes and an ask about the level of redaction needed for the ledger.

High-level plan and timeline (first pass):
- DPA / DPA Annex (including audit clause and onshore hosting options): draft by 2026-09-21.
- Article 30 ledger excerpt (redacted): initial extract by 2026-09-22.
- Subprocessor attestation bundle + SOC2 summary: packaged by 2026-09-23.
- DPIA support note (scope + our processing role + control map): 2026-09-24.
- KMS wrap & onshore options summary: 2026-09-24.

I've attached an internal checklist (audit_request_checklist.xlsx) to track the items. To align expectations: if ClearPath needs an onsite inspection or access to unredacted logs, that will require additional coordination and an NDA addendum — we can handle that but the timing will change.

Would you be open to a quick 30-min technical + legal sync tomorrow to confirm the ledger fields you need redacted and whether the DPA language should reference a specific SLA or be pilot-scoped?

Thanks — Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.example

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Team — forwarding ClearPath's asks (see below). Quick triage:

1) Art30 ledger excerpt: what columns can we safely include redacted for an external procurement packet? They want processing activities, categories of data, and subprocessors mapped to services.
2) Subprocessor attestation: do we have signed PDFs for the ones that touch pilot telemetry? Need to confirm which subproc IDs are in-scope for the pilot environment.
3) DPIA support statement: we should provide a short paragraph describing Redwood's role (processor), controls for model serving (isolation, KV cache handling, retention), and references to SOC2 + encryption in transit/at-rest.
4) KMS/onshore wrap: what options exist for pilot accounts in EU region and what's the friction for customer-managed keys?

Can each of you reply with availability for a 30-min sync and a one-line answer to the bullets above so I can confirm with Emma.

--Priyom

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Thanks for the ping — quick answers and action items below.

Art. 30 ledger excerpt: we can provide a redacted CSV containing processing activity name, purpose, categories of personal data, legal basis (contractual), categories of recipients (subprocessor names redacted to role, e.g., "GPU infra provider", "Monitoring provider"), and retention period. I'll prepare art30_ledger_excerpt_redacted.csv. For procurement packets we typically redact contract IDs and any internal asset tags.

Subprocessor attestations: we have signed attestation PDFs for the core infra and logging providers. I'll assemble a subprocessor_attestations_bundle.zip with a short index. SOC2 summary (SOC2 Type II date & link) will be included in the bundle.

DPIA support: I'll draft a one-page DPIA-support note that explains Redwood's processing footprint for model serving, the control set we apply (access controls, KV cache retention, token-level telemetry minimization), and one suggested wording you can paste into ClearPath's DPIA to reflect Redwood as the Processor.

KMS / key wrap: for the pilot we support customer-managed keys in the EU region via our KMS integration (customers can bring keys via supported KMS providers). Onshore wrapping (where keys are generated and retained in customer-managed KMS in EU) is feasible but requires a short onboarding checklist and a customer KMS test key exchange. I'll include kms_wrap_overview.pdf with steps and a recommended timeline (7-10 business days for key exchange + verification).

Timeline: I can deliver the items below by 2026-09-24 if we treat the ask as remote evidence only. If ClearPath requests unredacted logs or on-prem inspections, add 2-3 weeks.

Deliverables I'll produce: art30_ledger_excerpt_redacted.csv, subprocessor_attestations_bundle.zip, dpi a_support_note.docx (draft), kms_wrap_overview.pdf.

Availability: I'm free tomorrow 11:00-12:00 and 16:00-17:00 UTC for the sync.

Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.example

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@clearpathhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-20T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Thanks Priyom and Irene — that plan sounds good and the remote evidence approach will be fine for procurement. Two quick clarifications before you produce the ledger:

- Can the DPIA support note reference Redwood's role for pilot data specifically ("pilot telemetry and inference outputs"), plus a short statement on data minimization practices? Our privacy officer prefers specific scope wording.
- We want to confirm EU-only processing for the pilot (no egress to non-EU regions). If that's not possible, please indicate which subprocessors/processes may involve cross-border transfer and what safeguards apply.

If you can include both items in the DPIA note and confirm EU-only hosting for the pilot in the KMS overview, procurement will be comfortable with the timeline. We will target 10/04 for sign-off.

Best — Emma

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Data processing annex and onboarding — ClearPath EU pilot

Emma — noted. We'll scope the DPIA support note to call out "pilot telemetry and inference outputs" and add the data minimization paragraph. Irene will confirm the EU-only hosting status for the pilot in kms_wrap_overview.pdf; early answer: EU region-only deployment is available for pilot customers and KMS can be customer-managed in EU. I'll confirm any subprocessors with potential cross-border processing in the ledger extract. Expect the packet by 2026-09-24.

Talk soon — Priyom
